Hi Mark — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front, details/attachments below and happy to walk through on a quick call.

- Region pinning: For Redwood Dedicated, when a customer requests region pinning to a specific AZ/region (e.g., us-east-1) the provisioning and snapshot storage defaults to that region. Cross-region replication is opt-in; we will not replicate snapshots outside the pinned region unless you explicitly enable our DR replication option.

- Deletion evidence & timeline: We produce an operational playbook and deletion artifacts: (1) tombstone event with timestamp, (2) snapshot manifest entries showing snapshot IDs and object keys, (3) storage extent wipe logs with overwrite/zeroing audit, and (4) key-rotation KMS event when requested. Typical purge path: tombstone (immediate), storage-space reclamation/overwrite and metadata purge starts within 24-72 hours, and final block-level reclaim depends on underlying hardware — we provide signed deletion manifests within the agreed SLA window.

- Attestation & artifacts: We can share a signed deletion manifest (HMAC) and the snapshot manifest; for enterprise contracts we can include that language in the contract exhibit. Attached: "dedicated-region-homing-overview.pdf" with diagrams and a short sample manifest.

Next steps: Ben (sales) will propose a mutual action plan and timeline; Vanessa (solutions ops) can share the customer-ready wipe playbook and ops runbook. If useful, we can produce a short directed attestation for your legal team.

Would you like a 30-minute call Tuesday to walk through the artifacts?

Regards,
Laura Bennett

Hi Mark — thanks for the detailed questions. Summary of our guarantees for Dedicated (region-pinned) customers: 

1) Snapshot and archive locality
- Default behavior: all automated snapshots, monitoring snapshots, and customer-managed backups for a region-pinned Dedicated cluster are stored in the pinned region (e.g., us-east-1) by default. 
- Cross-region replication: only enabled when explicitly configured as part of a DR replication policy. We do not enable cross-region archival on your behalf. Long-term cold-archive exports are likewise opt-in.

2) Signed deletion manifests and evidence set
- When a customer requests tenant deletion we emit a deletion bundle that includes: tombstone event (RFC3339 timestamp), snapshot-manifest entries (object keys + checksums), storage-extent wipe logs (operation id + timestamp), and KMS key-rotation events if requested.
- We provide an HMAC-signed manifest using a Redwood signing key and include the public verification key and signature metadata in the bundle. The manifest includes object-level SHA256 checksums and RFC3339 timestamps.

3) Timeline and purge behavior (Dedicated)
- Tombstone: immediate when customer confirms deletion request.
- Operational wipe: metadata and block reclaim workflows begin within 24-72 hours; typical block-level overwrite and secure scrub completes within 45 calendar days depending on underlying hardware and pending maintenance windows.
- Snapshot chain expiration: any dependent snapshots are scheduled for expungement; final object removal from low-level storage may take up to 120 days for physical disk sanitization paths in certain on-prem mirrors.
- Audit artifacts: we retain deletion manifests and the signed verification bundle for 1 year in the customer-specific audit ledger (read-only) unless you request a shorter retention.

4) Monitoring snapshots
- Observability snapshots are tagged and stored in-region for region-pinned Dedicated clusters. We can provide a sandbox demonstration showing the tag and storage location metadata.

Attached: "capitolbank-wipe-playbook.pdf" (customer-facing runbook) and "replication-boundary-diagram.png" illustrating where backups live in the pinned configuration.

If you want the attestation to be notarized or embedded as exhibit text in the contract, our Legal can provide a short exhibit; Ben can include that in the MAP. Happy to do a short walkthrough of the artifacts.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Security & Compliance
